subject: flying cloak with a tail
picture: A large empty cloak flies through a dungeon hall. The cloak is spread open like wings. A simple face is on the inside of the cloth. One long tail trails behind it. Nobody is wearing it. No hanger, no feet, no hands. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
